name: Azure
label: Azure Resource Manager + data plane
description: Azure Resource Manager REST via OfficialApiNode. Docs: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/rest/api/azure/. Operations: blob_get, blob_put, blob_delete, blob_list, functions_invoke, servicebus_send, servicebus_receive, vm_get, vm_power, aks_get, keyvault_get, monitor_query, resourcegroup_get, listen. Every request sends x-ms-version: 2026-04-06 (latest fully deployed Storage REST version) and x-ms-date: RFC 1123 via extraHeaders (https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/rest/api/storageservices/previous-azure-storage-service-versions). ARM ops still use api-version query. Auth secret access_token is instance config only (never on INPUT, never logged). listen/trigger are kind:ingress — use a BPMN message start/catch/boundary event. JDK HTTP, official API only. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: Per-operation fields. Do not put secrets here. Path params such as id match api_spec.json placeholders.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Which official API call to run. EXACT values: blob_get | blob_put | blob_delete | blob_list | functions_invoke | servicebus_send | servicebus_receive | vm_get | vm_power | aks_get | keyvault_get | monitor_query | resourcegroup_get | listen. Prefer the instance config operation select. listen/trigger are ingress: they do not call HTTP — use a BPMN message event. Example: 'blob_get'.

schema.label: resourceGroup
schema.description: ARM resource group for VM / AKS / monitor ops. Example: prod-rg.

schema.label: vm
schema.description: Virtual machine name for vm_get / vm_power.

schema.label: api-version
schema.description: ARM api-version. Example: 2024-07-01.

schema.label: account
schema.description: Storage account name for blob_*.

schema.label: container
schema.description: Blob container for blob_*.

schema.label: blob
schema.description: Blob name for blob_get/put/delete.

schema.label: content
schema.description: Blob bytes for blob_put (Put Blob, sent as a BlockBlob). A platform file or a plain string. Required for blob_put. Example: the report.pdf file from an upstream node.

schema.label: restype
schema.description: Query-string parameter `restype` for operation: blob_list.

schema.label: comp
schema.description: Query-string parameter `comp` for operation: blob_list.

schema.label: functionApp
schema.description: Function App name for functions_invoke.

schema.label: functionName
schema.description: Function name for functions_invoke.

schema.label: payload
schema.description: JSON request body for functions_invoke, sent as the whole body to the HTTP-triggered function. Example: {"orderId":"1001"}.

schema.label: namespace
schema.description: URL path parameter `namespace` for operations: servicebus_send, servicebus_receive. Required by: servicebus_send, servicebus_receive.

schema.label: queue
schema.description: URL path parameter `queue` for operations: servicebus_send, servicebus_receive. Required by: servicebus_send, servicebus_receive.

schema.label: message
schema.description: Message body for servicebus_send, sent verbatim (a JSON object is serialized). Required for servicebus_send. Example: {"event":"order.created","id":1001}.

schema.label: timeout
schema.description: Query-string parameter `timeout` for operation: servicebus_receive.

schema.label: powerAction
schema.description: URL path parameter `powerAction` for operation: vm_power. Required by: vm_power.

schema.label: cluster
schema.description: URL path parameter `cluster` for operation: aks_get. Required by: aks_get.

schema.label: vault
schema.description: URL path parameter `vault` for operation: keyvault_get. Required by: keyvault_get.

schema.label: secret
schema.description: URL path parameter `secret` for operation: keyvault_get. Required by: keyvault_get.

schema.label: providerNamespace
schema.description: URL path parameter `providerNamespace` for operation: monitor_query. Required by: monitor_query.

schema.label: resourceType
schema.description: URL path parameter `resourceType` for operation: monitor_query. Required by: monitor_query.

schema.label: resourceName
schema.description: URL path parameter `resourceName` for operation: monitor_query. Required by: monitor_query.

schema.label: metricnames
schema.description: Query-string parameter `metricnames` for operation: monitor_query.

schema.label: timespan
schema.description: Query-string parameter `timespan` for operation: monitor_query.

schema.label: interval
schema.description: Query-string parameter `interval` for operation: monitor_query.

schema.label: aggregation
schema.description: Query-string parameter `aggregation` for operation: monitor_query.

schema.label: code
schema.description: Function-level key for functions_invoke as the code query parameter (alternative to x-functions-key / function_key). Leave empty for anonymous functions. Example: a key from Function App > App keys.

ports.name: output
ports.description: Success {status:ok, http_status, data}. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: Status
schema.description: Exact ok on HTTP 2xx. Absent on failure.

schema.label: HTTP Status
schema.description: Provider HTTP status code.

schema.label: Data
schema.description: Parsed JSON body from the official API, or raw text.
